title: THE REVELATION CHURCH - THE ELECT

blocks.text: I John 5:14, “And this is the confidence that we have in him that if we ask anything according to his will he heareth us!” And verse 15 says, and then if we believe he hears us then we already have our answer, whether it takes place immediately or gradually! – “The revelation church will be joined to the Headship Christ in perfect confidence as the age closes! Others will be scattered, but the bride will be united! And this group is predestined to sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus!” (Eph. 2:6) It says, “made us sit” together (preordained)! – Rom. 9:11 confirms this, “That the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth.”

Eph. 1:4, “He hath chosen us before the foundation of the world! Verse 5 reveals, predestinated according to his will! Verse 3 says, blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places with Christ!” – Eph. 1:10, “That in the dispensation of the fullness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ!” Verse 11 says, “Being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will!” – Eph. 3:9, “reveals that all men should see the fellowship of the mystery that has been hid in God, who created ALL THINGS by Jesus Christ!” Verse 10 reveals that the Church would know the intent and secrets of God in heavenly places revealed by the manifold wisdom of God, according to his eternal purpose in Christ Jesus our Lord! In which the Headship elect will receive boldness and confidence by the faith of him! (Verse 12). Jesus, under these principles that we are studying will release faith, divine love and word anointing to prepare His saints for translation! And revelate manifold secrets to them bringing them to heavenly positions! (Rev. 12:1, 5) The moon reveals the church exalted in high places like the Biblical eagle!”

“The Church is coming into line for a quick short work with the head!” – Eph. 1:22-23, “And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things to the church! Which is his body, the fullness of him that filleth all in all!” – Eph. 4:12-13 Paul says, “For the perfecting of the saints, till they come into unity of the faith and knowledge of who the Son is unto a perfect man the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ!” Verse 14, “The Headship people will not be carried about with every wind of doctrine or sleight of men!” – “Behold saith the Lord Jesus, my true church is coming together and shall be like unto this Scripture! Eph. 4:15, But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ!” – Yea in verse 5 it reveals, “One Lord, one faith, one baptism!” “And I will call them in one spirit and put upon them 7 revelative spirits to know the mysteries of the eternal one! (Rev. 4:5 – Rev. 10: 3-4,7) Yea, and the prophet of the Lord of Hosts is anointed to guide and lead them with my cloud of wisdom going before until the Lord saith come up hither!” (Rev. 4:1) – Col. 1:17-18, “reveals Jesus is before all things. It says that He is the Head of the body, the church. And He is preparing through these messages a very heavy anointing to reveal the wonders and mysteries of God!” – Verse 26 says, “Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages, but now is made manifest to His saints!” Col.2:3, “In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge!” Great and wonderful things are truly ahead. “He is certainly vindicating your calling to be with Him in His final thrust and to be a part of His glorious harvest! His rainbow presence actually surrounding His true bride the very throne power!” (Rev. 4:3 – Ezek. 1:28)

His elect will be like beautiful color stones, like Israel was to him! I Peter 2:4 “Disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God and precious. Verse 5, Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house! Verse 9, Ye are chosen, a royal priesthood! A peculiar people showing forth His praises! For His people will be royal stones of the King!” – “Behold saith the Lord, in this manner of the Scriptures that ye have read will I gather My people for this is my pre-ordained plan to bring them unto their position! Behold saith the Lord it will occur in like manner yea even exactly as this Scripture, Eph. 2:20-22, “And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone; In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit!” – “Yea saith the Lord, listen to the voice of knowledge, even to thee the voice of wisdom! Have ye not read and understood this Scripture. The main stone which the builders rejected is become the perfect head of the corner. (Mark 12:10) – Yea they cast out that which was perfect to receive that which is not perfect! Yea, even today men will cast out and reject My people as being in error and foolishness! They will cast the stones aside; but what is foolish to the world as Paul said, is valuable indeed to the Lord of Hosts! And the stones they cast out will fit in perfect place under the head, the very Capstone God! (the Lord Jesus Christ). Verse 11, This was the Lord’s doing and it is marvelous in our eyes!” – “Behold saith the Lord, take heed and listen, this letter was written by the authority of the Holy Spirit in prophetic knowledge and wisdom to make known the truth to a chosen people in preparation for My coming and that they may know and be led in the will of the Lord; as my body (elect) will be gathered to the divine head of leadership, the Bright and Morning Star!” (Rev. 22: 16-17) Amen!

“The Lord is revealing what He is doing and He is certainly going to bless and keep His people! O praise the Lord, you can just feel the pillar and cloud of fire going before us! Let us unite, work and pray together for a quick short work. For surely this is our hour to move swiftly, doing all that we can!” “ Also the Lord will reveal much more to us in the days ahead!” – “In closing remember, The wise built upon the rock!” (St. Matt 7:24) – “And Jesus said, upon this rock I will build My church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it!” (Matt. 16:18) – “Rejoice in His promises!”
In God’s abundant love and blessings,
